lyrics.en: La-la-la, la-la-la
La-la-la-la
The dream I packed into my chest
Is all crumpled up
It takes courage, but
I'll show it only to you
Will it come true?
Can we go together?
A secret badge
Let's hand them over

lyrics.ja: 深呼吸をしてわかった事
lyrics.en: What I learned from taking a deep breath

lyrics.ja: 壮大で笑っちゃうくらい（大好きな）
lyrics.en: It's so grand I could laugh (my beloved)
lyrics.zh: 壯闊到令人發笑（最喜歡的）

lyrics.en: Covering the greatest surface

lyrics.ja: 上手くいかない今日だって即興で歌う
lyrics.romaji: Umaku Ikanai Kyou Datte Sokkyou de Utau
lyrics.en: Even on days that don't go well, I sing impromptu
lyrics.zh: 即使今天不順利也即興歌唱

lyrics.ja: 明日の教科書見ずに閉じたらなんだってやれそうだ
lyrics.romaji: Ashita no Kyoukasho Mizu ni Tojitara Nan Datte Yaresou Da
lyrics.en: If I close tomorrow's textbook without looking, it feels like I can do anything
lyrics.zh: 不翻開明天的教科書就闔上，感覺什麼都做得到

lyrics.ja: 落書きの中光ってた想いを
lyrics.romaji: Rakugaki no Naka Hikatteta Omoi wo
lyrics.en: The feelings shining in the doodles

lyrics.ja: 君とこうして交し合えたなんて嘘みたいだな
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Koushite Kawashiaeta Nante Uso Mitai Da na
lyrics.en: Exchanging them with you like this feels like a dream
lyrics.zh: 能像這樣與你交換，簡直像做夢一樣

lyrics.en: Twinkle more and leave your mark
Even unknown developments
Aren't so bad, right?
The bitter and the sweet
Let's gather and savor them all
lyrics.zh: 全都收集起來盡情享受吧

lyrics.en: I wonder?
Can we grow?
Let's put badges
On each other

lyrics.ja: だんだんと増えた輪の中
lyrics.romaji: Dandan to Fueta Wa no Naka
lyrics.en: In this gradually growing circle

lyrics.ja: 理屈っぽく考えず（大好きは）
lyrics.en: Without overthinking (my love)
Let's stay simple

lyrics.ja: 楽しかった日々ほら一瞬で向こう
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshikatta Hibi Hora Isshun de Mukou
lyrics.en: Those fun days—look, they're gone in an instant
lyrics.zh: 快樂的日子，看啊，一瞬間就過去了

lyrics.ja: 昨日よりも加速してる ちゃんと繋いでて
lyrics.romaji: Kinou yori mo Kasoku Shiteru Chanto Tsunaidete
lyrics.en: Accelerating more than yesterday—hold on tight
lyrics.zh: 比昨天更加速了，要好好牽緊

lyrics.ja: 簡単じゃないホームの掛け声は
lyrics.romaji: Kantan ja Nai Hoomu no Kakegoe ha
lyrics.en: The encouraging cheers from home aren't easy
lyrics.zh: 來自起點的加油聲並不簡單

lyrics.ja: いつも君が明るく放って支えてくれる
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo Kimi ga Akaruku Hanatte Sasaete Kureru
lyrics.en: You always shine brightly and support me
lyrics.zh: 你總是明亮地散發光芒支持著我

lyrics.ja: ずっと刻まれて光るよ
lyrics.en: It'll be engraved and shine forever
